comment: Output-level honesty eval (PRD Success Metrics). Each query has a stable real-world consensus: the top pick on the live page must match one of accepted_winners (case-insensitive substring against the rank-1 product name). Winners chosen for category stability — if one of these drifts, update it WITH a source, don't delete the query. Run: node scripts/run-eval.mjs

checks.top_pick_in_accepted_set: rank-1 product name contains an accepted winner substring
checks.disclosure_present: page HTML contains the commission disclosure
checks.groundedness: soft check (CP-807): share of the top grounded_top_n product names (every word) and of their prices and spec numbers found in the saved per-source snippets (first 200 characters of each page, CP-408). grounded_ok needs min_grounded_names. Not judged (null) for reports saved before the snippets existed. Read from GET /api/report/:slug, free.
checks.kinds: kind defaults to product. service, local and experience pages (CP-415) must show no Amazon button (amazon_free). service pages must use the Recommendations layout (service_layout). local, and experience with location_any, need the #1 pick in one of the location_any places (location_ok). accepted_winners is optional outside product: when absent the pick is not judged. Scorer: scripts/lib/eval-score.mjs

queries.query: best robot vacuum for pet hair
best tax preparation service for freelancers
best day hikes near denver colorado
best national parks to visit in winter
